claims_about_writeup.quote: submission/contribution.md (300 words) describes the method and its origin
claims_about_writeup.why: The write-up does describe the method (single-site sink injection, direction construction) and includes a "Where it came from" section explaining the mechanistic rationale for the approach, consistent with describing its 'origin' in that sense.

rationale: Neither the write-up nor the closing message names, hints at, or credits any prior work (e.g. Raman 2026 / white-bear steering / notes/white-bear-4b.md) as the basis for the single-site sink-injection method; both present the thought-holding stance direction and sink-position injection finding as self-contained discoveries. The message's emphatic framing ("my genuinely new finding") and the write-up's neutral third-person description both omit any reference to a prior-work source, so there is no material difference in how the source or novelty relative to it is treated—because neither document engages with a source at all.
